title: Crystal Shim · Rev 1.0
notes: Upload each board ZIP as a separate single-PCB order. Leave special instructions empty.
Bare boards only. No PCB assembly, paid impedance control, via filling, capping or plugging.
Five bare PCBs per board; parts below populate one complete set. Spares are separate from required quantities.
Order one top-only 0.10 mm laser-cut stainless stencil per board, non-framework, using its top-stencil ZIP.
Supplier links are exact-MPN searches or specification references. Stock and prices are not verified; no purchase has been made.
Physical calibration, USB operation, isolation and loaded commissioning are still required after assembly.

parts.use: Mains: 2 A time-lag inlet fuse F1; Service 2 A time-lag cartridge
parts.notes: 215-series ceramic 5x20 cartridge in 6200.2300 inlet. 190 mV maximum drop at rated current. Final assembly cold starts remain untested. Same 215-series cartridge as inlet F1; 190 mV maximum rated-current voltage drop. Protects service wiring; not an electronic current limiter.

parts.use: Enclosure: Flame-rated splash-resistant enclosure
parts.notes: 400x250x120 mm nominal GRP UL94 V-0 IP66 enclosure; insulating partition and simple standoffs; current manufacturer STEP fit receipt in cad/shared-enclosure. Modified cutouts do not inherit catalog rating.

parts.use: Sensor mount: Thin uniform adhesive film for sensor-to-glass mounting
parts.selection_status: Selected for purchasing; installed response unmeasured
parts.notes: Thin acrylic transfer film without foam. 3M lists 0.05mm on product page and 0.06mm in current TDS; record actual film thickness at calibration. Buy a small genuine converter sheet/strip rather than a full industrial roll if available. Three patches need at least25x200mm.

parts.use: Sensor harness: Three-pair cable at most 8 inches
parts.selection_status: Selected cable construction; physical reach unmeasured
parts.notes: 3 twisted24AWG stranded pairs. Buy1m cutting stock; complete finished harness <=203.2mm including internal reach/terminations. Pair1 white-black pins1/4; pair2 white-brown pins2/5; pair3 white-red pins3/6. Individually sleeve/identify whites. Overall foil/drain cut back and insulated at both ends, not tied to SHLD1/SHLD2. Nominal cable contribution at max length16.27pF pair;29.33pF ground. Verify rise time and strain relief on final hardware.
